1.title: Hunter Biden tells BBC his pardon was 'not good' for America or his father's legacy
1.summary: In a wide-ranging BBC interview, the former president's son denied having any interest in running for office and spoke frankly on his father's declining health.

2.title: Schumer, Despite Party Tensions, Forges Ahead in Fight for Senate
